integrity: The theorem is analytically proved on its stated domain; finite checker experiments are supplemental. Comparison with an inaccessible plausible primary is explicitly unresolved. No independent validation performed.
scientific_limitations: The exact divisible-frequency minimum is not claimed, only strict constructive improvement; the nondivisible stability coefficient is not necessarily sharp. Phased sine harmonics, arbitrary Fourier combinations, arbitrary convex bodies and higher dimensions lie outside scope. A relevant 2011 primary full text was inaccessible, leaving a historical priority risk.
title: A divisibility dichotomy for two-mode constant-width area minima
